_readme: The frontier records: what the best current result IS, on each axis the field
measures. Potential-impact scoring never asks whether an item is important. It
asks whether the item beats one of these values. See section 3.1 of
docs/neurobase-potential-impact-build-spec-v1.0.md.
This file IS the manual entry interface. The app is a client-side SPA with an
anon read-only Supabase client and no auth, so there is nowhere to attach a
write form. A hand-written file reviewed in a diff is the honest equivalent,
and it is the pattern inclusion-basis.json already uses for curated decisions.
Applied by scripts/backfill-frontier-records.js, dry-run by default:
node --env-file=.env scripts/backfill-frontier-records.js
node --env-file=.env scripts/backfill-frontier-records.js --commit
Re-running is idempotent. Nothing is ever deleted.
EVERY RECORD MUST BE TRACEABLE. current_value carries its units in the string,
and source_url points at the paper, registry entry, or regulatory decision the
value was read from. The backfill script rejects a record missing either. Do
not enter a value you cannot link.
TWO KINDS OF CHANGE:
Correcting a record   edit its entry in place. The script bumps
record_version and logs every changed field.
The frontier moving   add a NEW entry with a new key, and set
"supersedes" to the old key. The old record is kept
exactly as it was, because historical scores were
computed against it.
Keys are slugs, stable forever: the record id is derived from the key, so
renaming a key creates a second record rather than renaming the first.
subfield must be one of SUBFIELD_IDS in src/lib/subfields.js. Note that
FOCUSED_ULTRASOUND and INTERFACE_MATERIALS cannot be derived from an item's
facets and can only be set here, by hand.
indication is REQUIRED when axis_type is "evidence" and forbidden otherwise.
It must be one of INDICATION_IDS in src/lib/indications.js.
POPULATING THIS FILE IS PHASE 2, NOT PHASE 1. Phase 1 built the mechanism.
The bootstrap is 5 to 10 axes across the subfields plus an evidence record per
indication, it is manual domain work, and it is on the critical path. The
records list is empty on purpose: an invented frontier value would be worse
than none, because every item in that subfield would then be scored against a
number nobody can source.

_comment: Shape reference only. NOT a record, and skipped by the loader like every
underscore-prefixed key. Placeholder values are deliberately unusable so
this cannot be copied into the records list without being filled in.
_example.axis: <what is being measured, including the population and conditions>
_example.axis_type: <performance | longevity | invasiveness | scale | regulatory | manufacturability | cost | evidence>
_example.indication: <one of INDICATION_IDS, only when axis_type is evidence>
_example.current_value: <the value, with units in the string>

held_by.id: <uuid of the NeuroBase item holding it>

_example.source_url: <link to the paper, registry entry, or regulatory decision>
_example.notes: <anything a reviewer needs, including why this axis is drawn this way>
_example.supersedes: <key of the record this one beats, omitted unless it beats one>
